shared_constraints: Create exactly one isolated neutral character key pose, centered and fully visible, using the supplied approved south-facing production sprite and character reference as binding design references. Crisp hand-placed pixel art with deliberately low internal pixel resolution, hard pixel edges, no antialiasing, no smooth vector lines, no painterly rendering and no photorealism. Preserve the exact costume, body proportions, palette, silhouette weight, upper-left lighting and fixed 3/4 top-down camera. Flat uniform pure magenta #FF00FF background with no gradient, floor, cast shadow, glow spill, particles, border, text, letters, numbers, labels, logo, signature or watermark. Do not use magenta in the character. One pose only; never draw a sheet, duplicate, inset, weapon variant, effect or alternate costume.

prompts.player_idle_north: The approved cyan non-attacking blessing mage in a neutral idle pose facing north/away from camera. Clearly show the back of the cyan hood and short mantle. Empty hands, no weapon.
prompts.player_idle_east: The approved cyan non-attacking blessing mage in a neutral idle pose facing east/right in the same 3/4 top-down view. Readable side-facing hood, mantle and feet. Empty hands, no weapon.
prompts.dasher_idle_north: The approved coral-red charging knight in a neutral idle pose facing north/away from camera. Preserve helmet crest, broad shoulders, compact shield and lance-like charge weapon with a readable rear silhouette.
prompts.dasher_idle_east: The approved coral-red charging knight in a neutral idle pose facing east/right in the same 3/4 top-down view. Preserve helmet crest, shield, lance-like weapon and wedge-shaped charging silhouette.
prompts.archer_idle_north: The approved violet piercing archer in a neutral ready pose facing north/away from camera. Preserve hood, lavender accents and long asymmetrical bow.
prompts.archer_idle_east: The approved violet piercing archer in a neutral ready pose facing east/right in the same 3/4 top-down view. Preserve hood, lavender accents and long asymmetrical bow with a clear east-facing firing axis.
prompts.minion_idle_north: The approved compact green dungeon minion in a neutral idle pose facing north/away from camera. Preserve the tiny rounded-square head-and-body silhouette, short limbs and simple clothing.
prompts.minion_idle_east: The approved compact green dungeon minion in a neutral idle pose facing east/right in the same 3/4 top-down view. Preserve the tiny rounded-square silhouette, short limbs and clearly smaller scale than humanoids.

animation_contract.west_derivation: nearest-neighbor horizontal mirror of approved east key pose
animation_contract.atlas_layout: one state per row; four six-cell direction blocks per row
animation_contract.transform_policy: deterministic integer-pixel translation, nearest-neighbor scale/rotation, palette-safe state tint and horizontal mirroring only
